emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to verify. Paste a list, or map in a field from another Actor's dataset.

apiKey.title: Verifox API key
apiKey.description: Your Verifox API key — create one in the Verifox dashboard (Settings → API keys) at https://verifox.ai. Verifications consume YOUR Verifox credits (free signup includes 1,000).

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many emails to verify in parallel (1–20). Higher is faster but uses your credits quicker.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL (advanced)
apiBaseUrl.description: Override the Verifox API base URL. Leave as default unless told otherwise.
